entries.title: Job 32:1
segments: ¶So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he [was] righteous in his own eyes. {to...: Heb. from answering}

entries.title: Job 32:2
segments: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God. {himself: Heb. his soul}

entries.title: Job 32:3
segments: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and [yet] had condemned Job.

entries.title: Job 32:4
segments: Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they [were] elder than he. {waited...: Heb. expected Job in words} {elder: Heb. elder for days}

words.text: than he. {waited...: Heb. expected Job in words} {elder: Heb. elder for days}

entries.title: Job 32:5
segments: When Elihu saw that [there was] no answer in the mouth of [these] three men, then his wrath was kindled.

entries.title: Job 32:6
segments: ¶And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I [am] young, and ye [are] very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion. {young: Heb. few of days} {durst...: Heb. feared}

words.text: . {young: Heb. few of days} {durst...: Heb. feared}

entries.title: Job 32:7
segments: I said, Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.

entries.title: Job 32:8
segments: But [there is] a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.

entries.title: Job 32:9
segments: Great men are not [always] wise: neither do the aged understand judgment.

entries.title: Job 32:10
segments: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.

words.text: to me; I also will shew

entries.title: Job 32:11
segments: Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst ye searched out what to say. {reasons: Heb. understandings} {what...: Heb. words}

entries.title: Job 32:12
segments: Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, [there was] none of you that convinced Job, [or] that answered his words:

words.text: unto you, and, behold, [there was] none of you that convinced

entries.title: Job 32:13
segments: Lest ye should say, We have found out wisdom: God thrusteth him down, not man.

entries.title: Job 32:14
segments: Now he hath not directed [his] words against me: neither will I answer him with your speeches. {directed: or, ordered}

words.text: against me: neither will I answer

entries.title: Job 32:15
segments: ¶They were amazed, they answered no more: they left off speaking. {left...: Heb. removed speeches from themselves}

entries.title: Job 32:16
segments: When I had waited, (for they spake not, but stood still, [and] answered no more;)

entries.title: Job 32:17
segments: [I said], I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.

entries.title: Job 32:18
segments: For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me. {matter: Heb. words} {spirit...: Heb. spirit of my belly}

words.text: me. {matter: Heb. words} {spirit...: Heb. spirit of my belly}

entries.title: Job 32:19
segments: Behold, my belly [is] as wine [which] hath no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles. {hath...: Heb. is not opened}

entries.title: Job 32:20
segments: I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer. {be...: Heb. breathe}

entries.title: Job 32:21
segments: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man's person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.

words.text: Let me not, I pray you, accept
, neither let me give flattering titles

entries.title: Job 32:22
segments: For I know not to give flattering titles; [in so doing] my maker would soon take me away.
